video.title: FULLTANK WEDNESDAY: Even Jesus Didn’t Say Yes to Everyone
video.description:
Learning to set healthy boundaries and drop excess baggage isn't selfish—it is necessary stewardship that protects your peace and opens room for God's best.

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #EvenJesusDidntSayYesToEveryone #Luke4 #PowerOfNo #FocusOnYourCalling #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #HealthyBoundaries #Grace

----

comments.author: @marie-f1p5q
comments.text: It’s true, though. Every time I say yes to something, I’m also saying no to other important things. It helps me figure out what I should focus on.

comments.author: @hH-qp9kx
comments.text: I need to say No more to people to be nice. Yes to following God more.

comments.author: @RATheBlueWolf2021
comments.text: Lord, Help me; Give me the courage to let go of my problems, hatred, addiction, lies, and fear of the future by saying a big "NO!"  I am saying the Biggest "YES!" to God and to You, Lord Jesus. I pray this in Your name, Amen.

comments.text: Amen 🙏. God bless you too Bro. Bo

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, you have all power to heal and to deliver. There is no trouble nor bondage you cannot overcome. Set us free to serve you joyfully and to love and serve others generously. May nothing hinder us from giving ourselves wholly to you and to your service. Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here! 2 Corinthians 5:17, NIV
Dear God Our Father in Heaven, open our hearts to see what is good in our lives. May the light in our hearts shine clearly so that we see, recognize, and live in accordance with what comes from eternity and belongs to our true nature, brought to us through Christ. Keep us from being blinded and deafened by experiences that will pass by. Help us to rise above them even in suffering and to wait patiently for what is becoming new and perfect. Praise to your name that we too can say, "The old has passed away; see, everything has become new!" In Jesus Christ Name. Amen.
